name: Wild Hunt Vanguard
body:
Wild Hunt Vanguard
CR 17

Before you stands a knight larger than life itself. 8 feet tall, with shoulders like a bull and enormous elk antlers spreading from the gleaming helmet of his thick armor. His gauntlets hold a monstrously large, foreboding mace with seemingly no effort at all.

XP 102,400
CN Medium fey (wild hunt)
Init +7; Senses greensight 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, see in darkness; Perception +35

DEFENSE

AC 35, touch 18, flat-footed 32 (+10 armor, +5 deflection, +3 Dex, +7 natural)
hp 287 (25d6+200)
Fort +16, Ref +17, Will +21
Defensive Abilities instinctive cooperation, wild grace; DR 15/cold iron; Immune cold; Resist electricity 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee +5 impact adamantine tetsubo +30/+25/+20 (3d8+25/19–20/×4), gore +20 (2d6+6/19-20)
Special Attacks crushing weaponry, wild gaze (DC 27)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +22)

Constant—know direction, speak with animals, speak with plants
At will—battering blast (DC 18), compel hostility (DC 16), wilderness soldiers
3/day—air walk, stone tell, strong jaw, wall of stone
1/day—legendary proportions, rain of arrows (DC 23)

STATISTICS

Str 35, Dex 17, Con 26, Int 15, Wis 24, Cha 20
Base Atk +12; CMB +25 (+32 bull rush); CMD 43 (45 vs. bull rush)
Feats Bull Rush Strike, Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Furious Focus, Greater Penetrating Strike, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (all), Improved Initiative, Penetrating Strike, Power Attack, Sickening Critical, Weapon Focus (all), Weapon Specialization (all)
Skills Acrobatics +31, Intimidate +30, Knowledge (nature) +30, Perception +35, Ride +28, Sense Motive +35, Stealth +31, Survival +32
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic, Sylvan; speak with animals, speak with plants
SQ planar acclimation, powerful build, warrior training, wild hunt link

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Crushing Weaponry (Su)

Any melee weapon picked up by a wild hunt vanguard becomes a +5 impact weapon for as long as the wild hunt vanguard holds it, reverting to normal afterwards.

Powerful Build (Ex)

A wild hunt vanguard is treated as one size category larger or its own size category, whichever is the most advantageous to him. For example, he can wield large weapons without penalties and has a +1 size bonus to CMB and CMD, but has no penalties on stealth or AC. His space and reach remain those of a medium creature.

Warrior Training (Ex)

A wild hunt vanguard is proficient with all weapons, armor and shields and counts as a 17th level fighter for the purpose of fulfilling prerequisites. All weapon-specific feats, like Weapon Focus, apply to all weapons for the wild hunt vanguard.

Wild Hunt Link (Su)

All creatures in wild hunt vanguard’s wild hunt link deal damage as if they were one size category larger with all weapons, natural or manufactured.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, or guard (1-4 plus 1 wild hunt monarch or wild hunt enchantress)
Treasure standard (mithral full plate of speed, adamantine tetsubo, other treasure)

Wild hunt vanguards are the newest addition to the groups of these isolated fey. The first of them were reportedly a creation of a wild hunt enchantress wanting to showcase her power to an arrogant monarch. Naturally, these powerful fey found the fact that their ability to create new wild hunt members is not unique and irreplaceable hard to reconcile. Still, none of them had any say in the matter, least of all the one who drew the ire of the creator enchantress. Still, every wild hunt monarch has to begrudgingly concede that the combat abilities of a vanguard are devastatingly useful, especially on a hunt for less elusive and more dangerous targets.

Wild hunt vanguards are footsoldiers through and through. What they lack in versatility, they more than make up for in their sheer strength, toughness and skill. A vanguard wields strength that is unexpected even for their enormous frames, enough to outwrestle a giant. That strength is multiplied in combat by their weapons, wielded with incredible skill and packing enough force to crumble a wall. In a hunt, they are most often tasked to draw the brunt of the enemy assault onto themselves and respond in kind, battering the target with might and allowing others to outflank and outmaneuver their prey, bringing it down with little risk to themselves.

While wild hunt vanguards now manifest spontaneously and need no creators, owing to the malleable nature of the fey homeworld, many monarchs eschew them due to their origin and heritage. Still, wild hunt vanguards are loyal to their masters and serve those monarchs that take them to their last breath. Others find employ as guards of enchantresses, which hold them in high esteem for the same reasons that the monarchs dislike them. While these beautiful, powerful fey rarely keep any other fey in their retinues, they find the idea of their personal wild hunt soldiers amusing and the abilities of vanguards useful in times when they can’t be bothered to solve issues with their overwhelming magic.

Wild hunt vanguards are never seen without their suits of thick, mithral armor, but are not bound to them in any way. An unarmored vanguard looks like a handsome, if grossly overmuscled elf with a rack of antlers resembling that of a majestic elk.
